items.entity: Vertical position of the right-edge load
items.description: The figures suggest mid-height, but no coordinate or loaded-node index is given.
items.evidence: Fig. 1(a): load arrow near right-edge mid-height; Fig. 3(b): approximately central junction. Secs. 2.1 and 3.1 give no load coordinate.

items.description: The force has no numerical magnitude.
readings: F=1000 in the same force units

items.entity: Volume fraction of the target illustrated in Fig. 3(b)
items.description: The caption does not assign a volume fraction to this target. Its black area suggests approximately 0.20, without establishing the exact sweep value.
items.evidence: Sec. 2.3 specifies a 0.01–0.95 sweep in increments of 0.01; the Fig. 3 caption identifies the cantilever target without its volume fraction.
